mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal a tightening monetary policy combined with a weakening labor market, which typically leads to a recessionary outlook and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market weakness
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise as specified, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand as measured by residential investment (RSAFS), the S&P 500 tends to exhibit positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 50th percentile, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust manufacturing activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to improved near-term corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the housing starts (HOUST) below 1900 thousand units over the past month signals weak consumer spending on durable goods, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1900, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, a rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that spurs recession fears, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% over the past month indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
